# react-spa-scaffolding

> Lightweight React SPA scaffold for rapid prototyping with Volvo Group Design System (VGDS).

Stack: React 19, Vite 8, TailwindCSS 4 + @volvo/vcdk-tailwind, @volvo/vcdk-react v2, @volvo/vcdk v10, TypeScript 6

## Source Structure

src/ - application source
src/App.tsx - root component with ThemeProvider, routing, theme switching
src/main.tsx - entry point with BrowserRouter
src/index.css - TailwindCSS + VGDS theme token imports
src/Navigation.tsx - side menu navigation
src/pages/ - route-level page components (HomePage, FleetPage)
public/ - static assets

## Key Files

AGENTS.md - AI agent operation guide, skills index
.github/copilot-instructions.md - always-on Copilot guardrails
.github/instructions/vgds-components.instructions.md - VGDS component rules for *.tsx
.github/agents/prototyper.agent.md - custom prototyping agent (recommended for UI work)
.vscode/mcp.json - GitHub + Figma MCP server config
.agents/skills/ - 7 VGDS design system skills
skills-lock.json - VGDS skill integrity tracking
vite.config.ts - Vite + TailwindCSS plugin + path aliases

## Design System

Uses @volvo/vcdk (core web components v10), @volvo/vcdk-react (React wrappers v2), @volvo/vcdk-tailwind (Tailwind preset).
Import components from direct subpaths: `import { Button } from "@volvo/vcdk-react/Button"`
TailwindCSS for layout/spacing only. VGDS tokens for colors/typography via CSS custom properties.
Themes: volvo-light, volvo-dark, mack-light, mack-dark, renault-light, renault-dark

## Commands

npm start - Start dev server (port 5173)
npm run authenticate - Authenticate to Volvo private npm registry
